messages:
Maria R.: Heads-up — I sketched a modular extract plan for the serving-side hotpath. Want to sync on guardrails so we don’t regress SLOs during the tranche cutover.
Devon K.: dropped the doc in /docs, skimmed. main worry is the DB-backed session store split and cache warmup.
Aj Patel: +1. If cache miss storm happens during cutover we’ll hit 3x latency. Need a throttled ramp and a KV prefill approach.
Sophia L.: agree. propose canary routing 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 48h with failure budget checks after each step.
Maria R.: TL;DR of the guardrails I had in mind: canary schedule, automatic rollback on 5xx spike or p50 latency > +30%, circuit breaker on dependent enrichers, telemetry gating.
Devon K.: add API contract enforcement: we should attach a lightweight compatibility check on every response from the new module and metric for unexpected schema changes.
Aj Patel: also need a migration plan for tenant-specific feature flags — some customers still call the old endpoint. can we shadow-serve?
Sophia L.: Shadowing is fine but expensive. Alternative: dual-write in adapter for 2 weeks + backfill job. Backfill job should be idempotent and rate-limited.
Maria R.: +1 to dual-write for writes. For reads we do sticky routing until cache is primed. Ops-runbook snippet:
```
# cutover checklist (abridged)
- disable autoscale burst
- start canary (1%)
- wait 30m smoke test
- if ok -> 5%, then 25% (48h window)
- run backfill job (rate 200r/s)
- monitor flags: canary_errors, canary_p50, enrich_latency
- if any rule tripped -> revert routing -> enable fallback
```
Devon K.: Can we add a short-circuit fallback that routes to a stable variant with lower throughput but guaranteed correctness when errors spike?
Aj Patel: yes — we already have model-variant fallback in router. Need to wire the policy: fallback if p95>500ms OR error_rate>0.5%.
Sophia L.: telemetry: capture request fingerprint + route_version so we can replay failing requests into staging. retention for these traces should be 30 days by default for canary runs.
Maria R.: Also thinking about ownership and tech-debt paydown: extract should include a clear interface contract and a deprecation ticket for old endpoints with dates + migration playbook.
Devon K.: reminder: data schema migrations (session blob) must be backwards compatible for 30 days. If we change shape, include a compatibility layer in adapter.
Aj Patel: scheduling: target staging cutover next Tue, production next Tue+2w. That gives 2 full sprints for feedback and infra fixes.
Sophia L.: QA checklist: unit tests for contract, integration tests with mock enrichers, chaos-sim that kills cache node and measures recovery.
infra-bot: deploy pipeline note — new pipeline job `mod-extract-canary` created. Triggers: manual + tag `mod-extract/canary`. Logs at https://ci.internal/runs/4821
Maria R.: thanks — can everyone ack this thread with any blockers by EOD? I’ll consolidate and open the cutover PR. :thumbsup:
Devon K.: ack — need to finalize backfill rate limiter.
Aj Patel: ack — will draft rollback automation for fallback routing.
Sophia L.: ack — I’ll prepare chaos tests and the telemetry retention request.
Maria R.: perfect. I’ll post the PR and runbook update tomorrow morning.
